note: apply_flag_settings {settings: {effortLevel}} sent on stdin between turns of a stream-json session (the arguments of chat.rs::build_claude_args, --model claude-fable-5 and no --effort) against a stub /v1/messages, with a settings.json already in the config directory. requests[i] is output_config.effort of the model request of the turn after applied[i]. responses holds Claude Code's answer to each request; nothing else reached stdout before it. claude_json_keys_added lists the keys .claude.json in the config directory gained between the first turn and the last.
